26258-elizabeth-hobart-at-exeter-hall.title: Elizabeth Hobart At Exeter Hall
26258-elizabeth-hobart-at-exeter-hall.creator: Jean K. Baird,
26258-elizabeth-hobart-at-exeter-hall.description: A book by Jean K. Baird,. During a summer shower barefooted urchins waded knee-deep in the gutters, their trousers rolled to their thighs. Irish-Americans shot mud balls at black-eyed Italians; Polanders and Slavs together tried the depths of the same puddles; while the little boys of the Russian Fatherland played in a group by themselves at one end of the square.

arxiv-2107-07828.title: Chi-square and normal inference in high-dimensional multi-task regression
arxiv-2107-07828.creator: Pierre C. Bellec and Gabriel Romon
arxiv-2107-07828.description: Abstract The paper proposes chi-square and normal inference methodologies for the unknown coefficient matrix 𝑩 ∗ \boldsymbol{B}^{*} of size p × T p\times T in a multi-task linear model with p p covariates, T T tasks and n n observations under a row-sparse assumption on 𝑩 ∗ \boldsymbol{B}^{*} .

arxiv-2308-10076.title: Sh -rigidity of Chevalley groups over local rings Thanks: Research of Boris Kunyavskiĭ was supported by the ISF grant 1994/20. A part of this research was accomplished when he was visiting the IHES (Bures-sur-Yvette). Support of these institutions is gratefully acknowledged
arxiv-2308-10076.creator: Elena Bunina, Boris Kunyavskiĭ
arxiv-2308-10076.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Elena Bunina, Boris Kunyavskiĭ. We prove that every locally inner endomorphism of a Chevalley group (or its elementary subgroup) over a local ring with an irreducible root system of rank > 1 >1 (with 1 / 2 1/2 for the systems 𝐀 2 \mathbf{A}_{2} , 𝐅 4 \mathbf{F}_{4} , 𝐁 ℓ \mathbf{B}_{\ell} , 𝐂 ℓ \mathbf{C}_{\ell} and with 1 / 3 1/3 for the system 𝐆 2 \mathbf{G}_{2} ) is inner, so that all these groups are Sh -rigid.

arxiv-2408-13346.creator: Cristina Ballantine, George Beck, Mircea Merca
arxiv-2408-13346.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Cristina Ballantine, George Beck, Mircea Merca. Given a partition λ \lambda , we write e j ​ ( λ ) e_{j}(\lambda) for the j th j^{\textrm{th}} elementary symmetric polynomial e j e_{j} evaluated at the parts of λ \lambda and e j ​ p A ​ ( n ) e_{j}p_{A}(n) for the sum of e j ​ ( λ ) e_{j}(\lambda) as λ \lambda ranges over the set of partitions of n n with parts in A A .

arxiv-2410-20912.title: An RSA Cryptosystem over a Halidon Group Ring of a Dihedral Group
arxiv-2410-20912.creator: A. Telveenus
arxiv-2410-20912.description: Abstract The article explores the creation of a cryptosystem using a halidon group ring of a dihedral group. Due to the non-abelian nature of the group, constructing the cryptosystem is more challenging compared to an abelian group. The logic used to develop a decryption programme was also quite complex.

arxiv-2503-19074.title: HingeRLC-GAN: Combating Mode Collapse with Hinge Loss and RLC Regularization
arxiv-2503-19074.creator: Osman Goni, Himadri Saha Arka, Mithun Halder, Mir Moynuddin Ahmed Shibly, Swakkhar Shatabda
arxiv-2503-19074.description: Abstract Recent advances in Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have demonstrated their capability for producing high-quality images. However, a significant challenge remains mode collapse, which occurs when the generator produces a limited number of data patterns that do not reflect the diversity of the training dataset.

arxiv-2505-21105.title: Identifying Compton-thick AGNs with Machine learning algorithm in Chandra Deep Field-South
arxiv-2505-21105.creator: Rui Zhang (张蕊), Xiaotong Guo (郭晓通), Qiusheng Gu (顾秋生), Guanwen Fang (方官文), Jun Xu (徐骏), Hai-Cheng Feng, Yongyun Chen (陈永云), Rui Li, Nan Ding (丁楠), Hongtao Wang (王洪涛)
arxiv-2505-21105.description: Abstract Compton-thick active galactic nuclei (CT-AGNs), which are defined by column density N H ⩾ 1.5 × 10 24 ​ cm − 2 \mathrm{N_{H}}\geqslant 1.5\times 10^{24}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-2} , emit feeble X-ray radiation, even undetectable by X-ray instruments. Despite this, the X-ray emissions from CT-AGNs are believed to be a substantial contributor to the cosmic X-ray background (CXB).

arxiv-2506-02000.title: NovelHopQA : Diagnosing Multi-Hop Reasoning Failures in Long Narrative Contexts
arxiv-2506-02000.creator: Abhay Gupta, Michael Lu, Kevin Zhu, Sean O’Brien, Vasu Sharma
arxiv-2506-02000.description: Abstract Current large language models (LLMs) struggle to answer questions that span tens of thousands of tokens, especially when multi-hop reasoning is involved. While prior benchmarks explore long-context comprehension or multi-hop reasoning in isolation, none jointly vary context length and reasoning depth in natural narrative settings.

arxiv-2507-04700.description: Abstract . Suppose 𝒵 \mathcal{Z} is the space of all tuples of operators on a finite-dimensional Banach space endowed with the joint numerical radius norm. We obtain the structure of the extreme points of the dual unit ball of 𝒵 . \mathcal{Z}.

arxiv-2511-00275.title: A Laplace transform of irregular growth
arxiv-2511-00275.creator: Jan Wiegerinck
arxiv-2511-00275.description: Abstract . We give an example of a Laplace transform ∫ γ e ζ ​ z ​ 𝑑 μ ​ ( ζ ) \int_{\gamma}e^{\zeta z}d\mu(\zeta) that does not have regular growth. This answers a question in [ 3 ] . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 30D10, 30D15 1.

arxiv-2511-13976.title: Exotic diffeomorphisms of 4 4 -manifolds with b + = 2 b_{+}=2
arxiv-2511-13976.creator: David Baraglia, Joshua Tomlin
arxiv-2511-13976.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by David Baraglia, Joshua Tomlin. Let X X be a compact, oriented, smooth, simply-connected 4 4 -manifold. The mapping class group of X X is defined as the group of smooth isotopy classes of diffeomorphisms of X X . The Torelli group of X X is the subgroup of the mapping class group consisting of smooth isotopy classes of diffeomorphisms which are continuously isotopic to the identity.

arxiv-2601-12203.title: Embryonic Exposure to VPA Influences Chick Vocalisations: A Computational Study
arxiv-2601-12203.creator: Antonella M. C. Torrisi, Inês Nolasco, Paola Sgadò, Elisabetta Versace*, Emmanouil Benetos*
arxiv-2601-12203.description: Abstract In young animals like poultry chicks ( Gallus gallus ), vocalisations convey information about affective and behavioural states. Traditional approaches to vocalisation analysis, relying on manual annotation and predefined categories, introduce biases, limit scalability, and fail to capture the full complexity of vocal repertoires.

pmc-10536429.title: Membrane–Fabric Composite Filter Media for Continuous Cake Filtration without Gas Throughput Using Paste Dot Coating with Adhesive
pmc-10536429.creator: Nikolai Benz, Fabian Krull, Kai Nikolaus, Sergiy Antonyuk
pmc-10536429.description: In the field of liquid filtration, the realization of gas throughput-free cake filtration has been investigated for a long time. Cake filtration without gas throughput would lead to energy savings in general and would reduce the mechanically achievable residual moisture in filter cakes in particular.

pmc-11479321.title: Development of Assistance Level Adjustment Function for Variable Load on a Forearm-Supported Robotic Walker
pmc-11479321.creator: Yuto Mori, Soichiro Yokoyama, Tomohisa Yamashita, Hidenori Kawamura, Masato Mori
pmc-11479321.description: With the progression of an aging society, the importance of walking assistance technology has been increasing. The research and development of robotic walkers for individuals requiring walking support are advancing. However, there was a problem that the conventional constant support amount did not satisfy the propulsion force required for the walking speed that users wanted.

pmc-11654195.title: Bedside teaching – insights into the medical student experience and likely impact on future role as clinical teacher
pmc-11654195.creator: Catherine Uhomoibhi, Angela Kearns
pmc-11654195.description: BackgroundMedical students and doctors are rarely taught how to be educators, but are expected to perform the role of clinical teacher once qualified (Kloek AT, Van Zijl ACM, ten Cate OTJ, Perspect Med Educ. 5:325–331, 2016). Qureshi (Perspect Med Edu 3:69–72, 2014) suggests that development of teaching skills should be incorporated into the undergraduate medical curriculum, while Charnell et al.

pmc-12457865.title: Therapeutic Drug Monitoring for Precision Dosing of Janus Kinase Inhibitors: Protocol for a Prospective Observational Study
pmc-12457865.creator: Jérémie Tachet, Laurent A Decosterd, Monia Guidi, François R Girardin, Javad Sarvestan, Sanja Arsić, Massimo Baraldo
pmc-12457865.description: BackgroundJanus kinase inhibitors (JAKIs) are small molecules used orally to treat inflammatory and hematological disorders. They have demonstrated impressive efficacy across multiple indications. However, concerns have emerged regarding their safety profile. Despite their growing clinical use, therapeutic drug monitoring is not yet established for JAKIs, but it could help address exposure-dependent efficacy and tolerability issues through individualized treatment approaches.

pmc-12636884.title: The research landscape and trends of dental pulp stem cell studies (2010–2025): A bibliometric analysis
pmc-12636884.creator: Yu Zheng, Zhe Tang, Lu Li, Zheng Li
pmc-12636884.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDental pulp stem cells (DPSCs) have emerged as a promising therapeutic modality in regenerative medicine, yet systematic bibliometric evaluation of global research landscape has been lacking.MethodsPublications from 2010 to 2025 were retrieved from Web of Science Core Collection.

pmc-13175816.title: Comparative molecular analysis of colorectal cancer in Saudi Arabia: distinct genetic alterations and clinical features
pmc-13175816.creator: Maha-Hamadien Abdulla, Jumanah Yousef Alshenaifi, Mansoor-Ali Vaali-Mohammed, Ahmad Zubaidi, Khayal Al Khayal, Noura S. Alhassan, Khalid Abdulrahman Al-Saleh, Omar Al Obeed, Scott Kopetz
pmc-13175816.description: PurposeGlobally, colorectal cancer (CRC) stands as the third most common type of cancer, a ranking that has remained consistent over recent years. However, the scenario diverges in Saudi Arabia, where CRC ascends to the forefront as the most common cancer among males and the second most prevalent among females.

pmc-13231066.title: Outcomes and recurrence trends after skin-sparing mastectomy and immediate DIEP flap reconstruction: A single-centre analysis
pmc-13231066.creator: Mahalakshmi Ishwar, Nazia Habiba, Nagy Rizkalla, Katy Wallis, Joanna Skillman
pmc-13231066.description: Introduction: Mastectomy is indicated in 25–40% patients diagnosed with breast cancer. Skin and Nipple sparing mastectomy (SSM / NSM) are techniques that allow for the option of a single stage reconstructive procedure. DIEP flap remains the gold standard for autologous breast reconstruction with excellent aesthetic outcomes.

pmc-13305167.title: Astragalus-derived nano-agonist potentiates chemotherapy by reducing tumor-suppressive macrophages
pmc-13305167.creator: Xuan Han, Yongbing Yang, Qiwen Lu, Zihan Zhang, Chengcheng Zhang, Xi Wang, Yueyi Huang, Hurong Shen, Qichen Zhan, Jing Chen, Peng Cao
pmc-13305167.description: Platinum-based chemotherapy only achieves a short-term success in the treatment of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), which is attributed to immunosuppressive macrophages post-chemotherapy. Herein, inspired by the plant immune defense mechanism, we demonstrate that edible astragalus-derived exosome-like nanoparticles (ADNPs) exhibit conspicuous efficacy in reprogramming M1-like tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) through the activation of TLR2 signaling.

pmc-13320423.title: Re: Ludovico Maria Basadonna, Federica Passarelli, Giorgio Graps, et al. The Influence of Music on Perceived Pain and Levels of Anxiety While Undergoing Transperineal Prostate Biopsy: The VIVALDI Trial. Eur Urol Open Sci 2026;87:107–14
pmc-13320423.creator: Francesca Vedovo

pmc-13332763.title: The Interaction of PI3K/AKT/mTOR Pathway with the Tumor Microenvironment: A Dual Engine Driving Breast Cancer Progression and Reshaping Treatment Strategies
pmc-13332763.creator: Xi Huang, Chunjun Xia, Xiangyue Jin, Yu Wang
pmc-13332763.description: The PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway, as a core regulatory network for cell growth, proliferation and metabolism, frequently undergoes abnormal activation in breast cancer, becoming a key driver of tumor occurrence and development. In recent years, research perspectives have shifted from solely focusing on intrinsic signals within tumor cells to the complex interactions between these cells and the tumor microenvironment (TME).

pmc-13411400.title: Plate fixation vs. intramedullary nailing: Which is more cost-effective for tibial shaft fractures?
pmc-13411400.creator: Seyed Houssien Saeed-Banadaky, Mehdi Raadabadi, Amir Mohammad Sotoudehnia, Rajabali Daroudi, Seyed Masoud Mousavi, Mohammad Ranjbar
pmc-13411400.description: IntroductionTibial shaft fractures are among the most common injuries resulting from trauma and are typically managed surgically via either plate fixation or intramedullary nailing. Given the constraints on healthcare resources and the imperative to control costs, evaluating the cost-effectiveness of these treatment strategies is essential.

pmc-13576462.title: Fahr syndrome in an 18-year-old male with pseudohypoparathyroidism: Clinical-radiological dissociation
pmc-13576462.creator: Syed Musa Mufarrih, Abida Akbar, Bushra Rehman, Saad Zaman, Fozia Memon
pmc-13576462.description: Fahr syndrome, characterized by bilateral intracranial calcifications, is a rare but clinically significant complication of chronic calcium–phosphate dysregulation in pseudohypoparathyroidism (PHP). Clinical manifestations frequently do not correlate with the extent of radiological findings, posing diagnostic challenges. An 18-year-old male with longstanding PHP presented with occipital headaches, carpopedal spasms, and depressed mood following more than two weeks of medication non-compliance.

uslaw-usc-t16-s706.title: 16 U.S.C. § 706 — Arrests; search warrants
uslaw-usc-t16-s706.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s706.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 7 (Protection Of Migratory Game And Insectivorous Birds); Subchapter II (Migratory Bird Treaty). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any employee of the Department of the Interior authorized by the Secretary of the Interior to enforce the provisions of this subchapter shall have power, without warrant, to arrest any person committing a violation of this subchapter.
